WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2023-12-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(curr.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       ROUND((curr.gross_revenue - prev.gross_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS mom_increase
FROM monthly_revenue curr
JOIN monthly_revenue prev ON prev.month = curr.month - INTERVAL '1 month'
WHERE curr.month >= '2024-01-01' AND curr.month < '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY mom_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 6) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS user_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders
    FROM jan_users u
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
        AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE non_cancelled_orders >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share
FROM user_order_counts

SELECT u.traffic_source, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete'
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_2024
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id

WITH facebook_users_2024 AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_non_cancelled_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users_2024 fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_non_cancelled_orders
),
first_two_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM second_order - first_order)) AS median_days
FROM first_two_orders

SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.id IS NOT NULL AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN u.id END)::double precision 
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 6
  ) AS share
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi 
  ON oi.user_id = u.id 
 AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
 AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
  AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH facebook_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
order_times AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM facebook_users)
    GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM order_times
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        r3.user_id,
        (r3.order_time::date - r2.order_time::date) AS days_diff
    FROM ranked r3
    JOIN ranked r2 ON r3.user_id = r2.user_id AND r3.rn = 3 AND r2.rn = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM second_third

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY user_spend)::numeric, 2) AS p90_spend
FROM (
    SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS user_spend
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id
) AS user_spends

WITH organic_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
-- For each user, find non-cancelled orders (orders with at least one non-cancelled item)
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi2
        WHERE oi2.order_id = oi.order_id
          AND oi2.status <> 'Cancelled'
    )
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
-- Filter to organic users acquired in 2024
organic_user_orders AS (
    SELECT uo.*
    FROM user_orders uo
    JOIN organic_users ou ON ou.id = uo.user_id
),
-- Rank orders per user
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
    FROM organic_user_orders
)
-- Get first and second orders and calculate median days
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second.order_time::date - first.order_time::date)) AS median_days
FROM ranked_orders first
JOIN ranked_orders second ON first.user_id = second.user_id
WHERE first.order_rank = 1 AND second.order_rank = 2

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        user_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        order_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn
    FROM order_values
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1)::numeric -
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn > 1)::numeric), 
    2) AS diff
FROM ranked

WITH orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, 
           MAX(user_id) AS user_id,
           MIN(created_at) AS order_time,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') AS non_cancelled_items
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') > 0
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MIN(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
           MIN(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
    FROM user_orders
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
),
day_diffs AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order)) / 86400 AS days_diff
    FROM first_two
)
SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff))::numeric, 2) AS p95_days
FROM day_diffs

WITH search_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT oi.user_id,
           oi.order_id,
           MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           order_id,
           order_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_two_orders AS (
    SELECT r1.user_id,
           r1.order_time AS first_order_time,
           r2.order_time AS second_order_time
    FROM ranked_orders r1
    JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_time::date - first_order_time::date)) AS median_days
FROM first_two_orders
